belt: rollers come off the top edge; the belt tile continues from there
notes: Scrapper Clans "Chain Drive": a greasy housing of two mismatched plates, hazard tape, a toothed sprocket in a window driving a chain (link dots crawl along it) up to the roller axle, a rough rubber belt with a rusty roller. On: the sprocket turns a quarter-tooth per frame (4 frames), chain links and treads move. JAMMED (2 frames): a bolt is wedged in the sprocket, the chain hangs slack, sparks, the red lamp flashes. Damaged: the chain has jumped a tooth and sags, plate cracked, tape peeling, sparks. Disabled: the chain snapped and lying across the housing, belt torn, sprocket bent.
